name: Magnum Opus
summary:
Magnum Opus is an extensive modlist for Fallout 4 that significantly expands and overhauls the base game while preserving its open-world RPG foundation.
The modlist combines hundreds of carefully selected and configured mods, adding new weapons, armor, quests, locations, gameplay systems, enemies and quality-of-life improvements. It also features extensive changes to combat, progression, crafting and settlement gameplay, alongside visual and performance enhancements.
Designed as a large-scale, cohesive Fallout 4 experience, Magnum Opus aims to provide considerably more content and gameplay variety while integrating its many additions into a unified playthrough.
Fallout 4 is required to play Magnum Opus.
